purpose: Prepared full native HTTP acceptance cases; no runner, runtime, users or services are created by this file

target_runtime.candidate_database: MariaDB 10.6.27; older separate receipt, not co-observed parity

excluded_parity_evidence: Current local PHP 8.3.21 / synthetic SQLite library harness
runtime_requirements: Authorized disposable runtime with separately owned empty database/config and temporary synthetic users
Loopback HTTP and owned session/state directories; no production config or forwarded production endpoint
No forced user, CSRF bypass, real grants or financial writer
Record effective native settings and source hashes without logging secrets

cases.name: guest
observe: Native login path is shown or redirected to
Employee form, own-draft list and protected values are absent
Zero module/native financial writes

cases.name: native_login
observe: Normal native login with random temporary fixture credentials and rendered native token
Following request fetches native user/entity and loads rights
Record pre/post session-cookie identifiers in redacted comparison only

cases.name: bad_password
observe: Native failure response cannot create an authenticated employee session
Zero draft writes
Failed-login delay and event handling remain native

cases.name: active_employee_save
observe: Own scoped form uses next native token
Native-valid POST saves one exact immutable module draft and redirects
Native expense/payment/bank/journal counts remain zero

cases.name: missing_token
observe: Module POST without token is rejected by native mandatory-token path
Zero draft writes

cases.name: stale_token
observe: Native clears POST and marks InvalidToken
Employee response rejects save without warnings or 503
Zero writes and no automatic retry

cases.name: current_next_token
observe: Record effective renewal setting
Real native request roll feeds currentToken to validation and newToken to forms
Test two-tab/back-button behavior without weakening native checks

cases.name: disabled_and_validity
observe: Fresh request after disabling only the synthetic account denies access
Expired and future-valid synthetic accounts are denied
No own-draft contents or new writes

cases.name: revoked_right
observe: Revoke only fixture direct/group creation grant in owned database
Next native request reloads rights and module denies access
No stale serialized permission grant

cases.name: invalidate_existing_session
observe: Synthetic flagdelsessionsbefore later than native login date invalidates cookie session
Subsequent module request has no authenticated draft access
Earlier invalidation timestamp does not cause a false positive

cases.name: logout_and_expiry
observe: Use native rendered logout URL and verify old-cookie replay loses access
Record effective logout token behavior rather than assume a macro is active
Expired/missing owned session state loses access without modifying global PHP settings

cases.name: identity_and_entity_scope
observe: Guest/external/admin-without-rights contexts cannot write
Forged owner/entity/office fields and another user's draft ID cannot widen scope
Legitimate entity switch is tested only if the reproduced target enables that feature

cases.name: retry_and_storage_failure
observe: Native-valid same-key retry maps to one immutable module draft
Changed intent conflicts without replacement
Owned synthetic storage failure discloses no internal data and creates no partial audit/draft

cases.name: cookie_and_headers
observe: Record actual HttpOnly/Secure/SameSite and session-cookie scope against test transport
Employee responses use no-store and expected CSP
Do not infer secure HTTPS acceptance from loopback HTTP

cases.name: bootstrap_and_factory
observe: Module resolves correct native bootstrap under the selected hosting path
Absent production factory fails closed with zero writes
Synthetic draft factory is bound to identical fetched native user and entity

cases.name: cleanup_and_evidence
observe: Capture exact source/PHP/engine versions, settings and per-case results without secrets
Remove only process-owned synthetic users/database/sessions/runtime
No persistent access, production mutation or financial posting
